types.SM.map_triangularInverse:
SM.map_triangularInverse.{u, v} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] (f : R →+* S)
  (weight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (Y : SM.BoundaryInterval n → R)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  f (SM.triangularInverse weight Y I) = SM.triangularInverse (fun J π => f (weight J π)) (fun J => f (Y J)) I

types.SM.triangularInversePolynomial_eval:
SM.triangularInversePolynomial_eval.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
  (weight : (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) → SM.IntervalComposition I → R) (Y : SM.BoundaryInterval n → R)
  (I : SM.BoundaryInterval n) :
  (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id R) Y) (SM.triangularInversePolynomial weight I) = SM.triangularInverse weight Y I
types.SM.nearFar_has_polynomial_inverse:
SM.nearFar_has_polynomial_inverse.{u} {n : ℕ} [NeZero n] {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [Invertible 2]
  (D H : SM.TripleArray n R) :
  ∃ Ψ,
    (∀ (Y : SM.IntervalArray n R),
        (SM.nearFarTransform D H fun I => (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id R) Y) (Ψ I)) = Y) ∧
      ∀ (X : SM.IntervalArray n R),
        (fun I => (MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom (RingHom.id R) (SM.nearFarTransform D H X)) (Ψ I)) = X

  (g a : ZMod n) : SM.geometricBoundaryArray (SM.shift a P) (g - a) = SM.geometricBoundaryArray P g
